card.name: Inside the word inadvertent
card.fires_on: The middle pieces of the word "inadvertent" (INAD-VERT-ENT), mostly in warnings about inadvertent intrathecal or intravenous administration. It also fires on the "animate" piece of "inanimate".

modes.label: Inadvertent in warnings
modes.description: Middle pieces of "inadvertent" in boxed warnings and risk headings about wrong-route administration.
modes.example: WARNING: RISKS WITH INAD<<VERT>>ENT INTRATHECAL ADMINISTRATION

modes.label: Inanimate in general text
modes.description: The piece after "in" in "inanimate" in ordinary prose.
modes.example: fire, fog, in<<animate>> objects, flowers, trees
